description: This file defines the ValidateMethodCondition class in the minilang module of the OFBiz framework. It implements a conditional operation that evaluates a method (via reflection) on a specified class with a given field value, used for validation purposes within the mini-language's scripting environment.

classes.name: ValidateMethodCondition
classes.description: Implements a conditional validation operation that invokes a static method via reflection on a specified class, using the value of a given field.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates the condition by invoking the specified static method with the field value as parameter.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the conditional operation, running nested operations depending on the condition result.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gathers artifact information from sub-operations for tracking.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Provides a detailed string representation of the operation for debugging.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the operation, including key attributes.

classes.comments: This class supports the mini-language feature '<if-validate-method>' used in OFBiz workflows to conditionally execute sub-operations based on a method's boolean result.

classes.name: ValidateMethodConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of ValidateMethodCondition, associated with the '<if-validate-method>' element.

methods.name: createCondition
methods.description: Creates a ValidateMethodCondition instance for a given element.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Creates a new ValidateMethodCondition as a method operation.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the factory element.

classes.comments: Registers and creates instances of ValidateMethodCondition within the mini-language parser.
